# tuanhuydev

> Personal site of Huy Nguyen Tuan, a fullstack software engineer based in Vietnam, working across Node.js backends and React frontends.

Huy writes about web development, micro frontends, AI in development, and code reviews.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tuanhuydev.com/): introduction, skills, and experience
- [Posts](https://tuanhuydev.com/posts): technical blog, sorted by newest first
- [Support](https://tuanhuydev.com/support): ways to support Huy's open-source work
- [Privacy & Terms](https://tuanhuydev.com/privacy)
